ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course starts June 14 and ends August 4. Classes will be on Monday and Wednesday evenings from 6:00 to 8:50 PM in the University Hall Building (UBH), room 2024 on the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. Students with current or recent supervisory experience are strongly encouraged to enroll in this course section. The email address for the instructor is tomward@illinois.edu.
